title: Tea for two 两个人一起喝茶
description: A dialogue between Susan and Peter. Susan invites Peter in for tea, but he must water the garden first because it's terribly dry. After a few minutes, Peter comes in and Susan notices it's raining, which means he doesn't need to water the garden. Peter says it's a pleasant surprise because now he can have tea instead. The lesson introduces 'have to' and 'had to', and the words water, terribly, dry, nuisance, mean and surprise.
answer_note: The listening comprehension question is a model answer (suggested). Workbook A (Complete the dialogue) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215). Workbook B (Structure) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215). Grammar I (answer with 'have to'), II (answer with 'have to'/'had to') and III (answer with 'must'/'don't need to') are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.560-561).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. Does Susan have tea by herself? 听录音，然后回答问题。苏珊是一个人喝茶吗？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。苏珊是一个人喝茶吗？

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?
lines.translation: 彼得，你现在能进来喝茶吗？

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Not yet. I must water the garden first.
lines.translation: 还不能。我得先给花园浇水。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Do you have to water it now?

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: I'm afraid I must. Look at it! It's terribly dry.
lines.translation: 恐怕我得现在浇。你看看，干得厉害。

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Last summer it was very dry, too. Don't you remember? I had to water it every day.
lines.translation: 去年夏天也是干得很。你不记得了吗？我不得不每天浇水。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Well, I'll have tea by myself.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: That was quick! Have you finished already?

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Yes. Look out of the window.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: It's raining! That means you don't need to water the garden.
lines.translation: 下雨了！这就是说，你不必给花园浇水了。

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: That was a pleasant surprise. It means I can have tea, instead.
lines.translation: 这是意想不到的好事。这意味着我反而可以喝茶了。

lesson.title: Does Susan have tea by herself?
lesson.instruction: Answer the question. 回答这个问题。
lesson.context: Comprehension question about whether Susan has tea by herself.

questions.prompt: Does Susan have tea by herself?
questions.answer: No, she doesn't. Peter comes in and they have tea together.

items.title: 1. have to (过去式 had to)
items.text: have to 不得不，必须。have to 强调客观需要多一些。must 则着重说明主观看法。

items.title: 3. by myself
items.text: 我自己，独自。同样，我们可以说 by yourself, by himself, by herself, by itself, by ourselves, by yourselves, by themselves, by oneself。

practice.title: Practice B: Structure
practice.instruction: Complete these sentences with by myself, by yourself, by himself, etc. 用 by myself, by yourself, by himself 等填空。
practice.translation: 用 by myself, by yourself, by himself 等填空。
practice.context: Workbook L125 B: complete sentences with by myself/yourself/himself/etc.

questions.prompt: No one can help, so I'll have to do the job ___.
questions.answer: by myself

questions.prompt: Susan, can you stay ___ for an hour?
questions.answer: by yourself

questions.prompt: I must go to the shops. You will have to stay ___, boys.
questions.answer: by yourselves

questions.prompt: His friend didn't want to see the film, so he went to the cinema ___.
questions.answer: by himself

questions.prompt: They always have tea ___ — just the two of them.
questions.answer: by themselves

questions.prompt: We live in the country so we spend a lot of time ___.
questions.answer: by ourselves

grammar.title: Grammar I: Answer the questions according to the example (have to ... and ... too)
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.560 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 answer items with 'have to ... and ... too'; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Do you have to clean the blackboard today?
questions.answer: Yes, I have to clean it today and I shall have to clean it tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Do you have to see the doctor today?
questions.answer: Yes, I have to see him today and I shall have to see him tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Do I have to cook lunch today?
questions.answer: Yes, you have to cook lunch today and you will have to cook lunch tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Does he have to serve in the shop today?
questions.answer: Yes, he has to serve in the shop today and he will have to serve in the shop tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Do you have to see the dentist today?
questions.answer: Yes, I have to see him today and I shall have to see him tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Does he have to wear that tie today?
questions.answer: Yes, he has to wear it today and he will have to wear it tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Does she have to help her mother today?
questions.answer: Yes, she has to help her today and she will have to help her tomorrow, too.

questions.prompt: Do you have to water the garden today?
questions.answer: Yes, I have to water it today and I shall have to water it tomorrow, too.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Answer the questions according to the examples (have to / had to)
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.560-561 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 answer items (2 groups of 6); items 1a, 1b and 2a are the printed examples.

questions.prompt: 1a. Do you have to take an examination today?
questions.answer: No, I don't have to take one today, but I had to take one yesterday.

questions.prompt: 1b. Does she have to type any letters today?
questions.answer: No, she doesn't have to type any today, but she had to type some yesterday.

questions.prompt: 1c. Do I have to water the flowers today?
questions.answer: No, you don't have to water them today, but you had to water them yesterday.

questions.prompt: 1d. Do you have to clean your bike today?
questions.answer: No, I don't have to clean it today, but I had to clean it yesterday.

questions.prompt: 1e. Do we have to clean the windows today?
questions.answer: No, you don't have to clean them today, but you had to clean them yesterday.

questions.prompt: 1f. Does he have to buy some butter today?
questions.answer: No, he doesn't have to buy any today, but he had to buy some yesterday.

questions.prompt: 2a. Do you have to go to school today?
questions.answer: No, I don't, and I won't have to go to school tomorrow, either.

questions.prompt: 2b. Do I have to go to bed early today?
questions.answer: No, you don't, and you won't have to go to bed early tomorrow, either.

questions.prompt: 2c. Do you have to do your homework today?
questions.answer: No, I don't, and I won't have to do my homework tomorrow, either.

questions.prompt: 2d. Does she have to wash any clothes today?
questions.answer: No, she doesn't, and she won't have to wash any clothes tomorrow, either.

questions.prompt: 2e. Do I have to do the shopping today?
questions.answer: No, you don't, and you won't have to do the shopping tomorrow, either.

questions.prompt: 2f. Do we have to hand in our papers today?
questions.answer: No, you don't, and you won't have to hand in your papers tomorrow, either.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Answer the questions according to the example (must / don't need to)
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.561 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 answer items with 'must ... but ... don't need to'; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Do I have to wear shoes and socks?
questions.answer: You must wear shoes but you don't need to wear socks.

questions.prompt: Do I have to wash my hands and face?
questions.answer: You must wash your hands but you don't need to wash your face.

questions.prompt: Do we have to close the door and the windows?
questions.answer: You must close the door but you don't need to close the windows.

questions.prompt: Does he have to wear a shirt and a tie?
questions.answer: He must wear a shirt but he doesn't need to wear a tie.

questions.prompt: Do we have to go to school today and tomorrow?
questions.answer: You must go to school today but you don't need to go tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Do we have to read the book and answer the questions?
questions.answer: You must read the book but you don't need to answer the questions.

questions.prompt: Do I have to clean my teeth and wash my hair?
questions.answer: You must clean your teeth but you don't need to wash your hair.

questions.prompt: Do you have to cook vegetables and fish for supper?
questions.answer: I must cook vegetables for supper but I don't need to cook fish.

questions.prompt: Does she have to look after the baby and the cat?
questions.answer: She must look after the baby but she doesn't need to look after the cat.

questions.prompt: Do I have to put on my coat and hat?
questions.answer: You must put on your coat but you don't need to put on your hat.
